description_en: Compares the similarity between two images
description_zh: 本接口用于对比两张图片相似值
name: CompareSimilarByImage

parameters.help_en:
The image content.

The image size cannot exceed 4 MB.
Image formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, WEBP, TIFF, and PPM.
The transmission wait time cannot exceed 5 seconds.
<props="china">
When the service type is product image search, generic image search, furniture and home furnishing image search, or industrial hardware image search, the image width and height must be greater than or equal to 100 pixels and less than or equal to 4,096 pixels.
</props>
<props="china">
When the service type is trademark image search, the image width and height must be greater than or equal to 200 pixels and less than 4,096 pixels.
</props>
<props="china">
When the service type is fabric image search, the image width and height must be greater than or equal to 448 pixels and less than or equal to 4,096 pixels.
</props>
<props="intl">
When the service type is product image search or generic image search, the image width and height must be greater than or equal to 100 pixels and less than or equal to 4,096 pixels.
</props>
The image cannot contain rotation information.

To call the operation by using an SDK: - Only SDK V3 is supported. You do not need to specify the PrimaryPicContent field. The SDK encapsulates this field into the PrimaryPicContentObject field and automatically converts it to Base64 encoding. For specific examples, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179188.html. - The SDK does not support directly passing image URLs. SDK V3 provides an alternative method to upload images by URL. For specific examples, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179188.html
parameters.help_zh:
图片内容。

图片大小要求不超过4 MB。
图片格式：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、WEBP、TIFF、PPM。
传输等待时间不超过5秒。
<props="china">
服务类型为商品图片搜索、通用图片搜索、家具家居图片搜索和工业五金图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于100PX且小于等于4096PX。
</props>
<props="china">
服务类型为商标图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于200PX且小于4096PX。
</props>
<props="china">
服务类型为布料图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于448PX且小于等于4096PX。
</props>
<props="intl">
服务类型为商品图片搜索、通用图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于100PX且小于等于4096PX。
</props>
图片中不能包含旋转信息。

使用SDK方式调用：- 仅支持V3版本SDK，无需填写PrimaryPicContent字段，SDK已将本字段封装为PrimaryPicContentObject字段并自动转化为Base64编码。具体示例参考 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179188.html。- SDK不支持客户直接传递图片URL，V3版本SDK提供了一种变相实现URL上传的方式。具体示例参考 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179188.html

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Image Search instance. The name can be up to 20 characters in length.
If you have purchased an Image Search instance, you can log on to the <props="intl">Image Search console (https://imagesearch.console.alibabacloud.com)</props><props="china">Image Search console (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com)</props> to view the instance name.
If you have not purchased an Image Search instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html.
The instance name here is not the instance ID. Distinguish between them when you use the instance

如果已经购买图搜实例可登录<props="intl">图像搜索管控台 (https://imagesearch.console.alibabacloud.com)</props><props="china">图像搜索管控台 (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com)</props>查看。
